title: Pricing Rule Bytecode
brief: Our pricing engine compiles each discount rule into a flat list of tokens in postfix order: each operator is written after the two operands it combines, so no parentheses are ever needed. The runtime has to compute the final integer value of a compiled rule.
Implement computeRuleValue(tokens), where tokens is the compiled rule as a list of strings, each either an integer or one of the operators +, -, * and /, and return the integer the rule evaluates to.
